passages.transcript:
Notes from a call with Northlight Digital about the website. Present: Sam Okafor and two people from Northlight.

They said site search is the next big job. It will use Search API and the library wants events and opening hours to come first in the results. It has to work with screen readers. Northlight first thought three weeks, but after looking at the events calendar they now say five weeks. Launch is planned for the week of 3 November. Sam mentioned in passing that the weather was awful on the way in. Northlight support is still weekdays 9am to 5pm, and urgent problems go to the on-call number. They also reminded us that editors must add alt text to every image, which has caused problems before.
passages.meeting:
Staff meeting, Harbourside Community Library, Tuesday morning. Present: Alex, the two branch assistants and the Children's Librarian.

Alex opened by saying the home delivery service has been a success so far and will carry on every Wednesday. Someone asked about the cafe: Dockside Coffee will keep running it and it stays open 9am to 4pm on weekdays. Nobody was sure about parking, so Alex checked and confirmed there are 20 spaces, free for two hours, with two blue badge bays by the entrance.

On events: the Language Cafe is still on Thursdays at 6pm in the meeting room, and Alex wants to add drop-in tech help on Mondays at 10am. The Children's Librarian said Toddler Storytime stays on Fridays at 11am. We agreed that lost property will be kept for four weeks and then given to charity. Oh, and somebody left a umbrella in the reading room again, which is not really a fact worth keeping.

Finally, the book sale: the trustees want it moved to the second weekend of June from next year.
passages.email:
Hi all,

A quick update on the Summer Reading Challenge for 2027. The theme this year is Ocean Explorers and it runs from 12 July to 31 August. It is free for children aged 4 to 11. Each child collects a sticker for every book they finish, up to six, and anyone who gets all six receives a medal at the finale. The finale was going to be on Saturday 4 September but we have had to move it to Saturday 11 September because the main hall is booked. Anyone helping at sessions needs a DBS check first, so please sort that out early. I will order the stickers by 1 June, as usual.

Thanks,
The Children's Librarian
